cards.back: Path of the business profile: ucp metadata (version, services, capabilities, payment_handlers) plus a top-level keys array.
Request header naming the platform profile, profile="...", in RFC 8941 dictionary syntax; meta ucp-agent over MCP.
Keep capabilities both sides list, pick the highest shared version, drop the rest, prune orphaned extensions until stable.
Optional, business-only map from older releases to leaf profile URIs.
Checkout status for buyer input or review; continue_url is required.
Absolute HTTPS handoff URL to the business UI; the platform must open it on escalation.
Complete accepted for async processing; no order yet; no new update or complete.
A spec written by a credential provider, such as com.google.pay, that the platform executes to get a token.
token, pan and network_token (number plus cryptogram).
Detached JWS over the JCS-canonical checkout without ap2, added by the business when AP2 is negotiated.
SD-JWT with key binding, required on complete, containing the full signed checkout.
Session state once AP2 is in the intersection: no fallback to unprotected checkout.
Signed replay protection: 128-bit entropy, stored 24 hours (48 recommended), 409 on payload mismatch.
Empty intersection, returned as HTTP 200 with a UCP error response and optional continue_url.
OAuth 2.0 authorization code with PKCE S256; scopes derived from capabilities; three access levels.
